description: The file defines the AppState class, an Observable object managing the application's global state, configuration, and interactions. It includes various properties for user preferences, connection settings, voice wake features, and configuration synchronization with external files. It also provides methods for applying configuration overrides, starting watchers, and managing voice wake triggers.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: A comprehensive observable class managing application-wide state, user preferences, connection configurations, voice wake settings, and interface with external configuration files.

methods.name: applyConfigFromDisk
methods.description: Loads configuration data from disk and applies necessary overrides.

methods.name: applyConfigOverrides
methods.description: Applies configuration overrides from a provided dictionary to update internal state and external configuration.

methods.name: syncGatewayConfigNow
methods.description: Synchronizes the current app configuration with external gateway config if needed.

methods.name: triggerVoiceEars
methods.description: Temporarily activates voice ears (microphone boost) for a specified duration.

methods.name: celebrateSend
methods.description: Triggers a celebration or visual indicator for send action.

methods.name: setVoiceWakeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice wake functionality, requesting permission if needed.

methods.name: setTalkEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode, requesting permission if needed.

methods.name: applyGlobalVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Sets voice wake triggers globally and schedules sync with the gateway.

methods.name: loadChime
methods.description: Loads a chime configuration from user defaults.

methods.name: storeChime
methods.description: Stores a chime configuration into user defaults.
